summary_en: On November 13, 2026, at the open of ToSTNeT-3 trading, IMURA will execute a share buyback order at the previous close of 879 yen per share, acquiring up to 40,000 shares for a maximum of 35.16 million yen.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock by Off-Auction Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
IMURA announced on November 12, 2026, that it will execute a treasury stock buyback on November 13, 2026, through the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading system. The company will submit buy orders at the previous day's closing price of 879 yen per share, with an upper limit of 40,000 shares for a maximum total amount of 35.16 million yen.

This execution implements a portion of the 100,000-share buyback authorization (capped at 100 million yen) decided by the board of directors on September 14, 2026, for the acquisition period from September 15, 2026, to January 29, 2027. The order is valid only during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading session on November 13, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. Results will be announced after trading closes.

Based on the treasury stock position as of September 30, 2026 (issued shares excluding treasury stock: 10,021,165), the planned acquisition of 40,000 shares represents approximately 0.4% of shares outstanding.
